title: 'This Is Gunda Gardi, What Authority Did You Have?': Uttarakhand High Court Slams Police For Detaining Politician En Route CJP Sansad March
description: The Uttarakhand High Court on Tuesday (July 21) orally questioned the State Police as to under what authority it had detained Uttarakhand Parivartan Party (UPP) president Prabhat Dhyani en route to the Cockroach Janta Party's march towards Parliament in Delhi on Monday.� At the outset the counsel for the State submitted before a division bench of Justice Ravindra Maithani and Justice Siddhartha Sah that the detention is "totally legal".� At this stage the court orally asked, "Under which law?
